title: Give each crop its own way of moving, instead of one sway for all of them
tier_reason: It is the difference between a cue bolted onto every plant and a farm where the plants have characters; cheap to build, but only meaningful once the designer has picked a motion draft.
ask:
The ripe-crop cue (Q-94) has a sway in it — draft A, and draft D at half the travel. Today the numbers are global: NOD_LEAN, NOD_RISE and NOD_PERIOD in systems/crop_presentation.gd, the same for wheat, tomato and pea, varied only by a per-square hash so no two plants are in step.

The designer's point, 2026-09-08: different crops should sway by different amounts. He is right, and it is the same principle the light channel already follows — C and D emit the crop's OWN ripe colour (RIPE_LIGHT), so 'the cue takes on the character of the plant wearing it' is already how half this feature works. A wheat ear whips; a tomato on a heavy vine nods slowly. One multiplier per crop, looked up exactly as RIPE_LIGHT is, sets the centre and the per-square hash keeps varying around it. Two levels: crop character, then plant-to-plant variation.

**The one risk, and the constraint it implies.** This is a STATE cue, not decoration. If wheat sways visibly and tomato barely does, a player can read the difference as a difference in how ready they are — which is a cue meaning the wrong thing, the failure this project cares most about. So the floor is: every ripe plant must move enough to be obviously moving. The per-crop number varies character above that floor; it never decides whether a crop is legible. Assert the floor rather than trusting the numbers.

If this lands, the sprite editor's per-crop page becomes the right home for that crop's number, beside its frames — which is where the designer expected to find it and where he will look again.
first_action: Unblocked 2026-09-08: the designer picked a moving draft, so this is work rather than deletion. Add a per-crop multiplier table beside RIPE_LIGHT in systems/crop_presentation.gd, feed it into the sway, assert the legibility floor for every growable crop, and put the crop's own number on its sprite-editor page.
source_message: Daniel, 2026-09-08: "I thought we'd just need to make different crops sway different amounts."
